place.name: Emulation Hall
place.description: The Emulation Hall, also known as Chatham Hall, is a former Masonic lodge building, now function centre, located at 3 Rochester Road in Canterbury, in the City of Boroondara, in the inner eastern suburbs of Melbourne, in Victoria, Australia. Built in 1928 on the traditional lands of the Wurundjeri people, the hall was added to the Victorian Heritage Register on 8 March 2012 in recognition of its architectural, historical, and aesthetic significance.
